name: Patras
text: Patras (; Greek: Πάτρα, romanized: Pátra pronounced [ˈpatra] ; Katharevousa and Ancient Greek: Πάτραι; Latin: Patrae) is the  capital and largest city of Western Greece, in the northern Peloponnese, 215 km (134 mi) west of Athens. It is Greece's third-largest city. The city is built at the foot of Mount Panachaikon, overlooking the Gulf of Patras.

depictions.name: Patrai
depictions.text: Patras Patrai (Ancient Greek: Πάτραι; Latin: Patrae) is a city in Greece which serves as the capital city of Achaia.
